Scenario fixture: role-img-text-alternative-present (“[role="img"] must have an accessible text alternative”)

This file intentionally includes many edge cases to test eligibility and rule outcomes. Each test element has a stable id of the form roleimg_case_XX. Native <img role="img"> elements are excluded by this rule (covered by img-alt-present).

A. Baseline (eligible)

01 — FAIL: role="img" with no aria-label/aria-labelledby (even with text content)
img notifications Text content alone is not a valid mechanism for this rule.
02 — PASS: role="img" with non-empty aria-label
img aria-label provides the alternative.
03 — PASS: role="img" with aria-labelledby referencing non-empty text
Bell icon img aria-labelledby provides the alternative.
04 — PASS: role="img" named via title only (last-resort HTML-AAM mechanism)
img title is an accepted last-resort mechanism for this rule.
05 — FAIL: role="img" with aria-label="" (empty)
img Empty aria-label does not satisfy the mechanism.
06 — FAIL: role="img" with aria-labelledby="" (empty attribute)
img Empty aria-labelledby does not satisfy the mechanism.
07 — FAIL: role="img" with aria-labelledby pointing to a non-existent id
img Dangling IDREF does not resolve to a name.
08 — FAIL: role="img" with aria-labelledby pointing to an existing but empty-text element
img Referenced element contributes no text.
09 — PASS: role="img" with both aria-label and aria-labelledby (aria-label alone suffices)
Labelledby text img Either mechanism resolving to a non-empty name is sufficient.

B. Visible but excluded from AT (ineligible)

10 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: aria-hidden="true" (not focusable)
img Ineligible per helper.

C. Hidden by HTML/CSS (ineligible)

11 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: hidden attribute
img Ineligible per helper.
12 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: display:none
img Ineligible per helper.
13 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: visibility:hidden
img Ineligible per helper.

D. Inertness (ineligible)

14 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: inert ancestor
img Ineligible per helper.

E. Exceptions that keep eligibility (focusable / IDREF)

15 — FAIL (eligible): aria-hidden="true" but focusable (tabindex="0"), no mechanism
img Focusable overrides aria-hidden eligibility; missing mechanism fails.
16 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: aria-hidden="true" with tabindex="-1" (programmatic focus only)
img Programmatic-only focus does not override aria-hidden eligibility.
17 — FAIL (eligible): IDREF-referenced aria-hidden element, no mechanism
Host references the icon by IDREF.
img IDREF override makes it eligible; missing mechanism fails.

F. Conditions that should NOT exclude eligibility

18 — FAIL (eligible): opacity:0, no mechanism
img Opacity does not exclude eligibility.
19 — FAIL (eligible): offscreen, no mechanism
img Offscreen does not exclude eligibility.
20 — FAIL (eligible): zero-size container, no mechanism
img Zero-size does not exclude eligibility.
21 — FAIL (eligible): aria-disabled="true", no mechanism
img aria-disabled does not exclude eligibility.

G. Non-composed content (ineligible)

22 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: inside <template>
tpl Template contents are not composed into the DOM:

H. Native <img role="img"> is excluded (own rule)

23 — NOT APPLICABLE (excluded by rule): <img role="img"> without aria-label
Native <img> is covered by img-alt-present, not this rule.

I. Aggregation / whole-rule behavior

24 — PASS candidate: eligible element passes; ineligible element missing mechanism should not fail
mix One eligible element has aria-label; the other is aria-hidden and ineligible.
25 — FAIL candidate: eligible element missing mechanism should fail even if other elements are ineligible
mix Eligible element (left) is missing a mechanism; other element is aria-hidden and ineligible.

End of fixture.
